package.welcome_message: Welcome to a 3-day family adventure through Amman, Ajloun, and Jerash - curated with authentic Jordanian experiences and local guides.

trip.title: Amman · Ajloun · Jerash
trip.summary: Three days of history and culture, each day staying in one region: Amman, Ajloun, then Jerash. Morning walks explore heritage sites, while afternoons offer shade, meals, and indoor visits.

planning.strategy: Each day stays in one area: Amman, Ajloun, then Jerash. Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon. About 3 places to visit and 2 meals each day.
assumptions: Travel times between cities are estimated qualitatively, not as exact minutes, unless evidence exists.
Opening hours are used only when present on the catalog record.

climate.typical_pattern: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
climate.outdoor_guidance: Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

decisions.title: Each day stays in one area
decisions.why: Mixing far-apart cities in one day makes the trip exhausting and confusing.
decisions.effect: Your days follow Amman, Ajloun, then Jerash.

decisions.title: Your first night is near the airport
decisions.effect: Night one is a hotel in Amman, as close to the airport as the listings allow.

decisions.title: Ease in after landing
decisions.effect: Transfer, eat, rest at the hotel. Sightseeing starts the next day.

decisions.title: Day trips from one hotel
decisions.why: These places are close enough to visit and return the same day.
decisions.effect: You keep the same hotel in Amman and come back there to sleep.

days.summary: Afternoon arrival in Amman: lunch, then rest. A quiet first evening.

schedule.name: InterContinental Jordan
schedule.description: Long-established five-star IHG hotel on Islamic College Street in Jabal Amman, between the Second and Third Circles, with six restaurants, indoor and outdoor pools, a spa and a 24-hour reception.
schedule.reason: Check in and rest through the hot / tired hours. Keep the first evening easy. 5-star stay, as requested

schedule.name: Dardasha Kitchen
schedule.description: A cozy neighborhood spot offering comforting Levantine home-style dishes, fresh daily specials, and warm hospitality.
schedule.reason: A simple dinner if the kitchen is still open, then sleep.

days.transport_notes: You land at 15:50. The drive from Queen Alia to Amman is about 45 minutes. Times below start after that transfer.

days.summary: Ajloun day focused on Al-Karakah Nature Trail, Ajloun Castle, and Ain Al-Tissis Lookout.

schedule.name: Al-Karakah Nature Trail
schedule.description: A peaceful municipal forest walking path running through pine and oak woods near Ajloun Castle.
schedule.reason: In Ajloun; local_tourism_catalog; A must-see in Ajloun; Matches history

schedule.name: Ajloun Castle
schedule.description: A 12th-century Muslim castle built by the Ayyubids to guard against Crusader incursions and protect local iron mines.
schedule.reason: In Ajloun; local_tourism_catalog; A must-see in Ajloun; Matches history, culture; One visit covering the nearby monuments
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Ain Al-Tissis Lookout
schedule.description: A scenic mountain bend overlook situated above forested ravines along the upper Ajloun circuit.

schedule.name: Ajloun Forest Reserve Restaurant
schedule.description: Scenic nature reserve restaurant in the Ajloun woodlands serving organic, locally sourced village buffets.
schedule.reason: In Ajloun; A must-see in Ajloun; Matches culture; Matches preferred cuisine

schedule.name: Summaga Cafe & Restaurant
schedule.description: Farm-to-table organic eatery managed by local cooperative selling regional sumac dishes, breakfasts, and local crafts.
schedule.reason: In Ajloun; Matches culture; Matches preferred cuisine

days.transport_notes: Come back to your hotel in Amman to sleep.

days.summary: Jerash day focused on Suf Village Heritage Center, Al-Kittah Village and Springs, and Churches of St. Peter and St. Paul.

schedule.name: Suf Village Heritage Center
schedule.description: A heritage village hub northwest of Jerash known for traditional stone houses, crafts, and ecotourism.
schedule.reason: In Jerash; matches culture interest; Matches history, culture

schedule.name: Al-Kittah Village and Springs
schedule.description: A rural agricultural village west of Jerash known for spring water, olive groves, and traditional farming.
schedule.reason: In Jerash; in requested region: Jerash Governorate

schedule.name: Churches of St. Peter and St. Paul
schedule.description: A 6th-century Byzantine basilica containing detailed floor mosaics depicting saints and fortified cities.
schedule.reason: In Jerash; local_tourism_catalog; One visit covering the nearby monuments
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Beit Khairat Souf
schedule.description: Historic stone home turned community kitchen in Souf, serving authentic home-cooked Jerash regional specialties.

schedule.name: Jerash Canyon Restaurant
schedule.description: Dramatic canyon-side restaurant in Jerash offering outdoor dining overlooking rocky gorge formations.

days.transport_notes: Come back to your hotel in Amman to sleep.
